339:0.en: 「I relay the words of the emissary of God!」

339:54.en: 「There is no mercy for those who refused God's salvation!」

339:91.en: 「The sentence will now be carried out!」

339:110.en: 「Know that it was all brought on by your own sin!」

339:193.en: 「We are $$真徒$$s. Executors of God's will!」

339:232.en: 「We are the guardians of the law!」

339:259.en: 「You are not permitted to attain $$シンカ$$!」

339:290.en: 「The Exalted Ones will decide your future!」

339:463.en: 「This is the universe where the gods dwell!」

339:494.en: 「Insolent trespasser, barging into\nthe universe where the gods dwell!」

339:621.en: 「No need to trouble the Exalted Ones!」

339:664.en: 「Behold the power the Exalted Ones gave us!」

339:703.en: 「This radiance destroys the evil that is you!」

339:742.en: 「This is proof of the Exalted Ones' power!」

339:777.en: 「This is proof of God's love for us!」

339:875.en: 「The sentence will now be carried out!」

339:999.en: 「We march on to what lies beyond!」

339:1024.en: 「This is the power of the chosen!」

339:1157.en: 「Fool! Return to the cycle of rebirth!」

339:1217.en: 「I attack until I see you erased!」

339:1289.en: 「Inorganic structures built by humans\nare nothing to us!」

339:1340.en: 「Don't think you can win with tools\nmade by foolish humans!」

339:1436.en: 「A product of the civilization of fire... $$ガンダム$$!」

339:1469.en: 「The tool to guide humanity to $$シンカ$$ has come!」

339:1504.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nA guidepost across parallel worlds!」

339:1590.en: 「You'll walk the path of $$シンカ$$\nno further!」

339:1639.en: 「Your evolution is merely\nthe entrance to $$シンカ$$!」

339:1772.en: 「These ones too are sprouts of evolution...\nNo, bearers of the seed!」

339:1823.en: 「Not enough to call yourself a machine super-god!」

339:1860.en: 「Just a machine god built by humans!」

339:1895.en: 「No matter the feelings you pour in,\nhuman civilization can't beat us!」

339:1960.en: 「Even a Demon God of Light can't match a true god!」

339:2058.en: 「I'll cut down the bud of possibility\nin that child right here!」

339:2109.en: 「Cower, child!\nWe embody the will of God!」

339:2162.en: 「Only the Exalted Ones are permitted\nto raise the sun aloft!」

339:2217.en: 「Even the moonlight that lights the dark\nis not permitted to you!」

339:2268.en: 「The twin factors of light and dark end here!」

339:2307.en: 「The power of love won't work in this universe!」

339:2348.en: 「Spill all the blood of the beast right here!」

339:2387.en: 「The best fit for the phrase\n'not knowing your place'!」

339:2438.en: 「God doesn't accept what is born\nfrom the mingling of waters!」

339:2491.en: 「Avenging the $$天翅$$s' bitter regret is impossible!」

339:2606.en: 「No miracles will happen! We won't allow it!」

339:2649.en: 「Even you who felled $$バアル$$ end here!」

339:2690.en: 「The wind's destination is beyond the causal horizon!」

339:2725.en: 「I'll snap that drill with God's will!」

339:2758.en: 「Power that changes the world's natural order ends here!」

339:2799.en: 「Suffer for trying to bend God's providence!」

339:2842.en: 「That power is not permitted to humanity!」

339:2875.en: 「Don't think tools of human-on-human war\nwill work on us!」

339:2965.en: 「A song...! Truly a surge of the power of life!」

339:3008.en: 「Wings that carry feelings?\nI'll tear them off!」

339:3180.en: 「You who qualify as a successor!\nKneel before us!」

339:3227.en: 「I'll teach you the fate of the foolish\nman who challenged God!」

339:3323.en: 「The man who buried a monstrous god!」

339:3356.en: 「Weapons are not permitted to seek\nto live as humans!」

339:3413.en: 「You who kill your own kind\nare not worth saving!」

339:3464.en: 「Offer that $$スフィア$$ to the Exalted Ones!」

339:3501.en: 「When all the $$スフィア$$s gather,\nthe universe will be saved!」

339:3552.en: 「You've done well to awaken the power\nof the $$スフィア$$ this far!」

339:3754.en: 「You have no place in this world!」

339:3785.en: 「I'll speed you to the next life!」

339:3816.en: 「The gospel will lead you to heaven!」

339:3941.en: 「I'll give you a chance to atone!」

339:4063.en: 「It's time to atone for your sins!」

339:4173.en: 「Learn that you reap what you sow!」

339:4417.en: 「Atone for the sin of attacking me.」

339:4552.en: 「Allow me to show you a battle\nworthy of a $$真徒$$!」

339:4601.en: 「Helping an apostle of God,\nthat is my happiness!」

339:4718.en: 「My iron will shall be your shield!」

339:4749.en: 「This body... is already devoted to you!」

339:4792.en: 「This is my cherished wish! My bliss!」

339:4829.en: 「I'll be the one to correct you!」

339:4887.en: 「Each one of us is worth a thousand!」

339:4920.en: 「My comrades and I purge these fools!」

339:4953.en: 「No time for you to fret over allies!」

339:5087.en: 「To cede the honor of the purge...」

339:5305.en: 「...Very well.\nI'll just pay this rage back double.」

339:5409.en: 「That was a fine chance to learn your place!」

339:5446.en: 「It's all in the palm of my hand!」

339:5570.en: 「I see your moves ten steps ahead.」

339:5722.en: 「Even a $$ガンダム$$ is\njust a product of human civilization!」

339:5816.en: 「Had you knelt to the Exalted Ones,\nyou could've become $$真徒$$s!」

339:5871.en: 「Steel giant gods are mere human idols!」

339:5908.en: 「A raging giant god indeed.\nIn a word: pathetic.」

339:5984.en: 「You fall short of bearing the sun.」

339:6015.en: 「So you can't master the $$ゲッター線$$.」

339:6056.en: 「You can't tap the power of light, it seems.」

339:6106.en: 「Taming a beast is an easy matter.」

339:6139.en: 「Mechanical Angel,\nweren't you to avenge the $$天翅$$s?」

339:6194.en: 「It seems your survival so far\nwas nothing but luck.」

339:6251.en: 「Is this the miracle you speak of?」

339:6280.en: 「With hard work and guts,\nsome worlds stay out of reach.」

339:6358.en: 「A sham god can go no further.」

339:6393.en: 「Neither love nor feelings can touch us.」

339:6434.en: 「The result of a disciplined soldier gone human.」

339:6477.en: 「Is that the power of your $$スフィア$$?」

339:6510.en: 「$$スフィア$$s are mere keys, after all!」

339:6551.en: 「Why did you think that would work?」

339:6586.en: 「This too is the Exalted Ones' protection.」

339:6619.en: 「'Feeble' is the word for that attack.」

339:6654.en: 「Why do you think you can fight like this?」

339:6801.en: 「Is this what you call an attack?」

339:6830.en: 「Won't you reflect on your own deeds?」

339:6869.en: 「I'll praise you for landing a hit.」

339:6896.en: 「Your spirit must be breaking by now.」

339:6927.en: 「Even now, you still won't give up?」

339:7008.en: 「I may need to rethink this a little.」

339:7041.en: 「I see...\nYou live up to the $$烙印$$ you bear.」

339:7090.en: 「A real fight, for the first time\nin 2,208 cycles...」

339:7268.en: 「Do you have the strength\nto make us get serious...!?」

339:7452.en: 「You'd surpass even the Exalted Ones' protection!」

339:7700.en: 「$$ガンダム$$! Power on this scale...!」

339:7817.en: 「Steel titan...! No, a super machine god!」

339:7950.en: 「This glow...! The power of the sun!?」

339:8024.en: 「Demon God of Light! Fully awake at last!?」

339:8067.en: 「Is this God's...\nNo, that man's iron will and pride!?」

339:8126.en: 「Wild instinct that surpasses reason!\nThere's no stopping this!」

339:8179.en: 「The mingling of waters...!\nA power that melds all into the new!」

339:8236.en: 「This is the man who killed a god...!」

339:8263.en: 「Right now, I'm being shown\na miracle wrought by humans...!」

339:8314.en: 「Hard work and guts...!\nHumanity's power to seek a future!?」

339:8451.en: 「The power of life...!\nTheir song shakes our very hearts!」

339:8500.en: 「Machine and human have fused,\ngiving birth to a new power!?」

339:8606.en: 「So this is a $$スフィア$$'s true power!」

339:8637.en: 「The $$スフィア$$s...\nHuman feelings beget great power!」

339:8733.en: 「No! We can't lose to mere humans...!」

339:8928.en: 「Please tell me, O God!\nWhat manner of beings are they!?」

339:9028.en: 「Our victory was promised to us!\nSo why!?」

339:9126.en: 「I-I've offered my life\nto the Exalted Ones! I know no fear!」

339:9189.en: 「I'm a $$真徒$$! On the $$シンカ$$ path,\nI'm a being beyond humanity!」

339:9334.en: 「This is possibility...!\nThe infinite future humans hold!」

339:9381.en: 「Are they on the path to $$シンカ$$!?」

339:9455.en: 「I-I am a $$真徒$$...!\nA being promised eternity...!」

339:9733.en: 「It can't be!\nWe were to pass the end of myth...!」
